purpose: Pin the personal profile's read-only usage measurements, UTC calendar and explicit incomplete state.
invariants: Unchanged parent and child transcripts reuse disposable metrics caches without rewriting conversation history.
Append, replacement, child-only changes, archive moves and deletion invalidate affected metrics.
Concurrent profile views share one pending aggregate read; failures release a subsequent retry.
Local activity settles independently of account identity, including failed identity reads.
Usage that predates turn clocks stays in lifetime totals; coverage gaps and skipped unreadable records are not surfaced as warnings.

valid.name: undated legacy usage is partial coverage, not a read failure
